name: Skylord Plume
summary: The Skylord Plume is taken from a Razorbeak Skylord in the Hinterlands. Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village seeks it as proof that one of these dangerous gryphons has been slain.

sections.title: A Hunter's Proof
sections.body: At Revantusk Village, Huntsman Markhor asks you to bring him a Skylord Plume. The Razorbeak Skylords are rare gryphons of the Hinterlands, and Markhor says they prey on troll hunters. He wants one slain and its plume returned as proof.

faq.answer: The Skylord Plume comes from a Razorbeak Skylord, a rare gryphon of the Hinterlands.
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village wants a Skylord Plume brought to him.
Markhor asks you to slay a Razorbeak Skylord and return with its plume as proof.

faq.q: Where can I find a Razorbeak Skylord?
faq.answer: Razorbeak Skylords are rare gryphons that occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why are the Skylords dangerous to trolls?
faq.answer: Markhor says the elder gryphons prey on troll hunters and raise offspring that also kill trolls.

angles.text: Markhor says Razorbeak Skylords have devoured troll hunters in the Hinterlands, making their threat close to home.
Huntsman Markhor calls on you to hunt a rare gryphon that preys on hunters in the Hinterlands.
